headline: Deferred decision on use of remaining funds until after summer events are completed
summary: The group reviewed finances, noting added costs for the ice cream truck at Fireworks and Liberty Tree Day, and put off deciding how to use any leftover funds until September or October. Members also planned details for the August 14, 2026 Liberty Tree planting, including participants, speakers, and promotion.
decisions: Deferred the decision on how to use any remaining funds until September or October, after all events are completed and invoices are paid.
